title: Quantum Transformer: Accelerating model inference via quantum linear algebra
formerTitle: Quantum linear algebra is all you need for Transformer architectures
authors: **Naixu Guo**, Zhan Yu, Matthew Choi, Yizhan Han, Aman Agrawal, Kouhei Nakaji, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, Patrick Rebentrost
summary: The operations inside a Transformer expressed through quantum linear-algebra routines, with the parameter regimes in which inference is faster.
